name: CI Wheels
intro: Cast iron wheels offer high load carrying capacity and excellent wear resistance. Suitable for high temperature applications such as ovens and foundries. Available in plain bore and ball bearing, as wheel only, fixed caster, swivel caster and swivel caster with brake.
features: Cast iron casting — machinable and free from blow holes
High load carrying capacity with excellent wear resistance
Suitable for high temperature applications such as ovens and foundries
BB effort is 50% less than PLB
IMPORTANT: CI wheels make noise and being very hard may cause floor damage — not suitable for polished floors
Available in Plain Bore (PLB) and Ball Bearing (BB)
